text.en:
Dealing damage to enemies gradually generates 'Perched' <strand/>Threadlings at a maxium rate of one <strand/>Threadling every 2 seconds.

Scoring kills also generate progress towards creating a Perched <strand/>Threadling based on <link Combatant Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Minors, Elites, and Minibosses: 33%
• Players: 67%
• Bosses: 100%

Casting your Class Ability creates three <strand/>Threadlings and simultaneously deploys all Perched <strand/>Threadlings.

Threadlings grant 10% Class Ability Energy per hit.
